headline: Thursday Heat: Upper 90s on the Lake
lede: Thursday, September 17th delivers a hot and humid day in Branson with highs near 98°F under mostly sunny skies. First-time visitors should plan lake time for morning or evening, seek air-conditioned shows in the afternoon, and stay hydrated — classic late-summer Branson weather that rewards early starts and indoor matinees.

featured.title: White River Fish House Spotlight
featured.why: Fresh fish, lake views, and a relaxed vibe perfect for a hot day. Excellent for first-timers seeking a memorable meal with water views. Representational photo from catalog.

plan.title: Cool Morning on the Water
plan.detail: Beat the heat with an early Table Rock or Taneycomo cruise, fishing, or breakfast with a view. Temperatures are most comfortable before 10 AM.

plan.title: Air-Conditioned Entertainment
plan.detail: Head indoors for a matinee show or shaded attraction. Avoid peak afternoon heat on the water or hiking.

plan.title: Lakeside Evening
plan.detail: Enjoy dinner as the sun sets and temperatures drop into the low 70s. Lake House or Landing venues shine at dusk.

indoor.name: Sight & Sound Theatre
indoor.detail: Spectacular productions in a cooled theater. Book ahead — perfect escape from the heat.

indoor.name: Legends in Concert
indoor.detail: Afternoon celebrity tribute show with live band and comfortable seating. Strong matinee option.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: High-energy country music and comedy in a climate-controlled venue. Family-friendly and reliable.
